entries.zh: 因為傳訊息很快，我可以整天跟朋友保持聯絡，這讓我能花更多時間維繫感情。
entries.wrong: when I have a slight thought of chatting with friends, I can simply just sending the words I want to say, and my friends would receive the message simultaneously
entries.correct: Because sending a message takes only a few seconds, I can stay in touch with my friends throughout the day, allowing me to devote more time to maintaining our relationship.
entries.errtype: 因果推論沒有寫出來，讀者必須自己腦補中間的邏輯鏈（easy messaging → low cost → invest more time → stronger relationship）；另外「just sending」應改為「just send」，情態動詞 can 後面要接原形動詞。
entries.fix: 把中間的因果關係用連接詞或分詞構句明確寫出來（allowing me to / which means that），不要只丟一個事實加一個結論給讀者自己推。
entries.concept: Development 維度看的是論證因果鏈是否完整外顯，事實與結論之間要有讀者不用腦補的橋樑。

entries.zh: 有更多共同話題會讓朋友更願意花心力在彼此的對話上。
entries.wrong: making people willing to invest more energy discussing about the new topic with each other
entries.correct: Having more shared topics gives friends more reasons to invest energy in their conversations.
entries.errtype: discuss 本身已含「討論關於」的意思，discussing about 是贅字錯誤；making people willing to... 的因果表達也偏鬆散、不夠精準。
entries.fix: discussing about → discussing；並把 making 開頭的鬆散因果句，換成更精確的名詞化主詞句構（Having more shared topics gives…）。
entries.concept: Language 維度要抓贅字與固定搭配（collocation）錯誤，動詞後面該不該接介係詞要靠記憶固定用法。

entries.zh: 這段實習經歷幫助我理解了專業團隊裡責任是怎麼分工的。
entries.wrong: made me familiar with how responsibilities are divided within a professional team
entries.correct: helped me understand how responsibilities are divided within a professional team
entries.errtype: made me familiar with 語氣被動、不夠精確，屬於用詞精準度不足的問題。
entries.fix: 換成更主動、更貼近想表達語意的動詞片語 helped me understand。
entries.concept: Language 維度：用詞精準度，被動描述可以換成更主動、更精確的動詞片語。

essays.topic: [081926] Could AI improve the lives of people?
essays.response: In my opinion, I totally agree with Student B’s idea that AI has the potential to solve many of the world’s problems, which will improve the lives of people. In addition, I would add that AI is propelling lots of progress in designing novel protein structures, which has conquered multiple difficult problems. For instance, AlphaFold has made new enzyme discovery, which could help people to handle plastic pollution crisis, thereby improving the quality of our environment. Plus, DeepMind AI has predicted millions of harmful DNA mutations, which could prepare biologists for targeting the real problems accurately. Also, AI develops molecular syringe that can help cure cancer, which accelerates the process of generating of drugs to handle the illness. Overall, I believe that AI is exactly the tool that can deal with harmful problems, in a sense that biological and chemistry expertise could identify and generate proteins for the given issues, and ultimately improve our quality of lives.

corrections.wrong: AI is propelling lots of progress in designing novel protein structures, which has conquered multiple difficult problems.
corrections.correct: In addition, I would add that AI is propelling significant progress in biomedical research, helping scientists develop biological solutions to difficult problems.
corrections.errtype: 主題句裡面的designing novel protein structures跟二三論點裡面的mutation/cancer不夠切題，因為這個技術是identification不是design。更好的切題是直接說"develop biological solutions to difficult problems."說明「解決問題」而不是「設計蛋白質」。
corrections.fix: 更好的切題是直接說"develop biological solutions to difficult problems."說明「解決問題」而不是「設計蛋白質」。
corrections.concept:
AI 題目的重要通用句型：
如果題目討論 AI 在醫療、生物科技、疾病、環境等領域的應用，可以用一個較大的 Reason 統整不同科技例子，而不要把 Reason 限縮在某一個技術。

corrections.wrong:
For instance, AlphaFold has made new enzyme discovery, which could help people to handle plastic pollution crisis, thereby improving the quality of our environment. 
Plus, DeepMind AI has predicted millions of harmful DNA mutations, which could prepare biologists for targeting the real problems accurately.

corrections.correct:
1. For instance, DeepMind AI has predicted millions of harmful DNA mutations, allowing biologists to identify disease-causing mutations more accurately. 

2. Building on this progress, AI can analyze the structures of potential drug molecules and identify promising candidates, enabling scientists to develop targeted treatments for specific diseases.

3. From there, AI has also helped scientists develop molecular syringes that can deliver drugs directly to cancer cells, making cancer treatment more precise and effective.
corrections.errtype: 骨架正確，但是 hierarchy 還可以整理得更漂亮
corrections.fix:
可以使用這一個Progressing關係: Prediction → Treatment → Recovery

AI predicts disease risks / harmful mutations.   → [Predict]
                                   ↓ Identify potential medical problems
AI helps scientists discover new proteins / drugs.   → [Discovery]
                                   ↓develop solutions to those problems
AI helps deliver drugs directly to cancer cells.   → [Treat]
                                   ↓ apply those solutions to patients

連接詞使用: For instance → Building on this progress → From there
corrections.concept:
PROGRESSING: 讀者讀完 Example 1 之後，Example 2 能自然地把論證往下一個方向推；Example 3 再把它推到更完整的結論。
Method1: individual → community → society
Method2: minor problem → major problem → critical problem
Method3: identify problem → understand problem → solve problem
Method4: prediction → diagnosis → treatment

essays.revised: In my opinion, I totally agree with Student B’s idea that AI has the potential to solve many of the world’s problems, which will improve people’s lives. In addition, I would add that AI is propelling significant progress in biomedical research, helping scientists develop biological solutions to difficult problems. For instance, DeepMind’s AlphaMissense has predicted millions of potentially harmful DNA mutations, allowing biologists to identify disease-causing variants more accurately and prioritize promising targets for further research. Building on this progress, AI has helped scientists analyze the structures of potential drug molecules and identify promising candidates, enabling them to develop targeted treatments for specific diseases. From there, AI has also helped scientists develop molecular syringes that can deliver drugs directly to cancer cells, potentially making drug delivery more precise and effective. Overall, I believe that AI is exactly the tool that can address difficult biological and medical problems, in the sense that it can help scientists identify disease risks, develop biological solutions, and apply them more precisely, ultimately improving people’s quality of life.
